title: Playing with Kid Rena and Buddy Petit
summary: Morris sat in on cornet at the Come Clean hall; Rena and Buddy Petit were the best cornetists, but Rena's drinking was a problem.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends
